title: Brisk Walking
steps: Warm up with easy pacing for 3 minutes
Walk at a brisk pace for 25–30 minutes
Cool down with 5 minutes of easy walking

title: Swimming or Water Aerobics
steps: Start with 10 minutes of easy laps or water walking
Build to 20–30 minutes at moderate effort
Stretch shoulders and hips after

title: Bodyweight Squats
steps: Feet shoulder-width, chest up
Lower until thighs are near parallel
Drive through heels to stand — 2–3 sets of 10–12

title: Forearm Plank
steps: Elbows under shoulders, body in a straight line
Brace core and glutes
Hold 20–40 seconds — 3 sets

title: Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Kneel on one knee, squeeze glute on back leg
Gently shift hips forward until mild stretch
Hold 30 seconds each side — 2 rounds

title: Pelvic Floor Awareness
steps: Identify muscles used to stop urine flow briefly
Contract 3 seconds, relax 3 seconds — 10 reps
Practice relaxation during daily activities

title: Cycling
steps: Adjust seat so knee is slightly bent at bottom pedal
Ride 20–35 minutes at conversational pace
Include 5-minute cool-down

title: Light Interval Training
steps: 5-minute warm-up walk or jog
1 minute faster / 2 minutes easy — repeat 6–8 times
5-minute cool-down
